column3: removed the _lightVersion field from the LightBase interface in src/light/types.ts
reworded the src/light/types.ts doc comment to say "the w component of vLightData" instead of naming vLightData.w
in getPackedSingleLightType (src/material/pbr/pbr-renderable.ts) added packed++ before continue for lights without _writeLightUbo, so that file counts skipped lights
in src/loader-gltf/gltf-feature-lights-punctual.ts changed "lightNodeCount > MAX_LIGHTS" to "lightNodeCount !== MAX_LIGHTS", so the loader also lowers the cap
none (one of the six files, src/loader-gltf/gltf-feature-lights-punctual.ts, wraps the getter and compares nothing)
widened setLightDiffuseColor in src/light/set-light-diffuse-color.ts to accept { diffuse } or { diffuseColor } and write whichever the light has
removed the engine._applyLightFoOffset call from _writeTaskLightsData in src/render/scene-lights-ubo.ts, so task light UBOs keep raw world positions
in rect-area _validateLighting (src/light/rect-area-light.ts) changed the missing-enable throw new Error to console.warn with the same message
moved the _installRectAreaEmission(prepareEmissionLighting) call from inside processAreaLightTexture to module top level in src/light/process-area-light-texture.ts
none (one of the six files, src/light/enable-rect-area-lights.ts, is the light-side installer, not material code)
moved the loop that sets mat._clusteredLightState from addClusteredLightContainer into the per-frame _clusteredLightUpdater in src/light/clustered.ts, so it runs every frame over all current meshes
